title: Information Accessibility and Corporate Innovation
eligible_reason: Single common event date. In main_dataset.dta, post = 1 if year > 2010 for all firms (variable label; crosstab confirms post = 1 exactly for 2011-2016), treat_post = treat x post, and event-time dummies are defined from t = year - 2010. Treated firms' first treated year is 2011 for 255 of 270 firms; the 15 later 'first' years are firms entering the panel after 2011, not later adoption. One adoption cohort, so not staggered. All columns also include time-varying firm controls (Size BTM Leverage Cash PPE ROA RnD LnFirmAge InstOwn); Table 6 adds peer_post; Tables 7-9 split treat_post by subgroup.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Chinese A-share listed firms 2007-2016 (4,303 firm-years). Tables 3-4, 10-12: reghdfe y treat_post $control, absorb(stockid year | ind_yr | ind_yr prov_yr), cluster(stockid). Table 5 / Figure 3: treat_d_2 treat_d_1 treat_d1 treat_d2 treat_d3 around 2010. Table 2 is a stock-return event study (CARs).
screener_notes: Title from ReadMe.txt (not in candidates.csv; authors not listed in package). Single 2011 post date with time-varying controls.
